visible_turns.text: Is this the Friendship Hospital ? Please send an ambulance to 68 Hu Nan Road .
Of course . It's urgent . I think the partie nt is suffering from acute appendicitis . He may die if not treated in time .
( after a while ... ) Where's the patient ?
Don't worry . We'll put him in the stretcher . You are coming with us ? Step in please .
